title: Job Application Cover Letter
description: Connect relevant experience to a specific role.
content:
Dear [Hiring manager],

I am applying for the [Role] position at [Company]. Your work on [Specific initiative] aligns with my experience in [Relevant field].

## Relevant experience
In my role at [Previous company], I [Concrete achievement], resulting in [Measurable outcome]. I also [Second relevant example].

## Why this role
[Explain your interest and how your skills address the job requirements].

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to [Team or goal]. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
[Contact details]
use_cases: 求职申请信 求职信 应聘 自荐信
